summary: Short 7,500px service hub: pale centered head with two buttons and three chips, an intro split with three figure tiles, four service cards, a numbered case study, a dark pricing band with two plan cards, four reasons with ISO badges, two office cards and a dark contact form block.

sections.note: pale blue ground, centered two-line title, one-sentence lead, one orange filled and one outlined button, then a row of three small tick chips. No photo.
left: heading with one orange word, a paragraph, four tick bullets and a button; right: a rounded team photo with a row of three big figure tiles over its lower edge
centered heading and a line; four white cards in a row, each with a small line icon, a title, two lines and a 'learn more' link
case study: a photo left with an orange quote panel and two big figures beneath; right a numbered list of four blocks (client profile, challenges, needs, solutions) with bullets
dark band: heading, paragraph and a button left; two white plan cards right, each with a icon, plan name, a from-price and an orange quote button; no table
heading with two ISO badges to the right, four cards (quality, security, scalability, pricing) with an icon and a paragraph
centered heading and line, two office cards (city, phone, email, address); no map
rounded dark block with an orange swirl: heading with an accent word left; a white form card right with a two-tab switch (send request / schedule a call)
